SLNS Tissa

data.subject: EXPEDITION OF DEFECT RECTIFICATION WORKS - WATERFRONT JETTY

paragraphs.text: Reference (a), you are hereby directed to coordinate with the Command Civil Engineering Department to facilitate immediate defect rectification at the Waterfront Jetty.
The nominated CE working party will commence bollard reinforcement and deck concrete repair operations with effect from 26 October 2026.
You are requested to ensure berthing clearances and unhindered vehicle access for equipment transport during work hours.
Progress report is to be rendered to this office upon completion of Phase 01.

data.subject: RECONSTRUCTION AND WATER SUPPLY UPGRADE AT WARDROOM COMPLEX - SLNS TISSA

paragraphs.text: I have the honour to submit for your kind consideration and approval please that an on-site structural and plumbing inspection was carried out at the Wardroom Complex of SLNS Tissa.

The existing main distribution pipe network has developed severe corrosion resulting in recurring pressure drops and significant wastage of potable water. A comprehensive Bill of Quantities (BOQ) and structural drawings have been formulated by this department.

The total estimated cost for the proposed replacement works amounts to Rs. 1,485,000.00 (Rupees One Million Four Hundred and Eighty-Five Thousand only). Detailed cost breakdown is forwarded herewith at Annex A.
In view of the urgency, it is respectfully recommended that administrative and financial approval be granted to initiate departmental procurement and execution.
